title: Midnight Quiche Delight
description: A rich and savory quiche filled with caramelized chives and a hint of midnight cheese, perfect for a satisfying dinner.
instructions: Roll out the French pie crust and place in a 9-inch tart pan.
In a skillet, caramelize the chopped chives over medium heat until golden brown.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the oaky butter, craving cream, and eggs.
Sprinkle the midnight cheese over the pie crust, followed by the caramelized chives.
Pour the egg mixture over the cheese and chives.
Season with shattering salt to taste.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until the quiche is set and golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
